_note: Single source of truth for the observation taxonomy, read by scripts/new_observation.py (at import time), tools/serve.py (served as-is at /taxonomy), assets/js/map.js, and tools/observation-form.html (both fetched, same as data/tutrakan-streets.geojson). docs/data-taxonomy.md is the hand-written, human-readable companion to this file - the two are kept in agreement by scripts/check_taxonomy_sync.py, run in CI via .github/workflows/check-taxonomy.yml on every change, not by remembering to update both.
